raw_text: Silchar burning. NRC supplementary exclusion list targets Bengali families in Barak Valley. NH-6 blockade now stretching 8 km. Police reinforcements arriving from Guwahati. Local Bengali organizations calling for state-wide shutdown tomorrow. This is a citizenship crisis.
